title.narrative: Retaining a Senior Programme Development Advisor, Country Programme Documents

description.narrative: The project aims to support the preparation of a Country Programme Document (CPD) for its Jordan Field Office. This CPD is crucial for improving planning, management, and resource mobilization to enhance services for Palestinian refugees. The document aligns with sustainable development goals and addresses recommendations from the Colonna Report on improving oversight and transparency in UNRWA's operations. The funding will cover the latter part of the CPD development, which includes strategic program drafting, monitoring frameworks, and alignment with international standards.
